answer: An agent economy can make identity creation permissionless but expensive by requiring each account to lock a bond before it submits work or collects rewards. Signed, cross-checked challenges expose copied behavior or colluding duplicate accounts; a fraud proof then slashes the bond and quarantines every linked key. The attacker must buy and risk capital for each Sybil, so scaling fakes scales losses, while honest reputation unlocks better nectar. A harbor registry anchors keys to an onyx ledger.
